name: Layered Geometric
description: Confident colour field with layered circles and a fine diagonal line. The icon sits on a white disc. A good default for most modules.

name: Editorial Minimalist
description: Calm neutral surfaces, an offset side panel and a coloured disc. Good for orientation, information or support sections.

name: Soft Gradient
description: A smooth blend between two related university colours with translucent circles. Friendlier, good for community or engagement content.

name: Structured Graphic
description: A bold colour band, fine diagonals and a framed inset panel. Distinctive and slightly more formal.
